Summary: Cobalt Zenith (large EU-based research firm) evaluating Redwood Dedicated + Private for a RAG search portal. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking at scale (target ~40M indexed docs initially, expected to grow). Key asks: EU data residency, customer-owned KMS keys, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence, ability to run a dedicated GPU pool behind their VPC.

Requirements (technical):
- Workload: enterprise research portal with vector search + cross-encoder reranker for final scoring. Staff calls it 'hybrid retrieval + rerank' repeatedly.
- Scale: initial index 30–50M docs (PDFs, research notes, analyst models). Expect 10–20M new vectors/year.
- Latency targets: interactive search p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms for first-stage ANN; end-to-end (with reranker) p50 < 400ms, p99 < 1200ms for worst-case.
- Cost sensitivity: target unit economics ~$0.003–$0.01 / query (depends on reranker usage). Asking Redwood Optimize for batching/caching suggestions to hit cost target.
- Model preferences: open models for embeddings (400–1024 dim), prefer Redwood-verified embeddings models and an on-prem cross-encoder for reranking (quantized). Will evaluate 4-bit quantized variants.
- Routing/fallback: must be able to fallback to a smaller reranker or cheaper model if dedicated pool degraded.
- Deployment: Dedicated capacity behind customer VPC, customer-managed KEK (KMS) in EU region, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.

Stakeholder quotes / call snippets:
- CTO: "We cannot accept any residency ambiguity — keys and data must stay in EU."
- Head of Research Ops: "If average query cost is >€0.01 with reranking we won't be able to scale to all teams."
- SecOps: "Need SAML, SCIM, and a retention policy for logs of 7 years; pen-test timeline must be agreed before pilot."

POC plan (agreed in principle):
1) Pilot ingest: 5–10M docs first week to validate indexing pipeline and dedupe / doc-splitting heuristics.
2) Scale to 40M over 4 weeks; measure index size (vectors), shard counts, and query latency under realistic qps (target 150 qps burst).
3) Run A/B: ANN-only vs ANN + cross-encoder rerank on same prompt set, measure quality lift and cost delta.
4) Security gating: deliver SOC2/ISO evidence + KMS workflow approval to SecOps.

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal needs explicit deletion SLA for EU data and contract appendix for key escrow (they want proof keys never leave their KMS).
- Procurement needs final pricing for 24/7 dedicated pool + optional burst.
- Ops needs clarity on maintenance windows and hotfix cadence.

Action items (short):
- SE (Maya) to run dedicated sizing calc and deliver cost per qps matrix by 2026-03-10.
- AE (Jordan) to provide contract template and estimated ARR range.
- Security to share pen-test schedule and SAML metadata exchange template.

Internal notes: they are leaning heavily toward Redwood Dedicated + Private; primary competitive threats are Pinecone/Weaviate combined with self-hosted cross-encoder, and Elastic Cloud with a custom reranker. Emphasize Redwood's unified routing (dedicated -> fallback hosted variants) and Optimize recommendations for batching/caching to meet their cost targets.
